title: Corporations Amendment (Simple Corporate Bonds and Other Measures) Bill 2013

speeches.speaker: Tony Smith
speeches.brief: Announced the coalition would not oppose the Corporations Amendment (Simple Corporate Bonds and Other Measures) Bill 2013, noting it took the Treasurer almost three years to bring forward a corporate bond market reform first flagged in December 2010, and cautioned that restricting use of the terms 'financial planner' and 'financial adviser' from 1 July 2013 risks becoming a first step toward unnecessary red tape.

speeches.speaker: Deb O'Neill
speeches.brief: Argued for the Corporations Amendment (Simple Corporate Bonds and Other Measures) Bill 2013, explaining it will expand the corporate bond market for investment access and restrict the terms 'financial planner' and 'financial adviser' to protect consumers from unlicensed or unscrupulous operators.

speeches.speaker: Bill Shorten
speeches.brief: Summing up debate on the Corporations Amendment (Simple Corporate Bonds and Other Measures) Bill 2013, explained the reforms follow the 21 May 2013 start of retail trading in Australian Government Bonds on the ASX, and would let ASIC take action against property spruikers falsely claiming to be financial advisers.
